_about: Editorial life periods for Theodore Roosevelt, in four facets. Periods within a facet may not overlap; periods in different facets do. Dates are anchored to the day entries in the TRA Chronological Record (cited in 'anchor'). 'verified': false means an editor has not yet confirmed the boundary against a second source.

facets.life_stage: Broad chapters of TR's life (every day belongs to exactly one)
facets.office: Public offices and military service (days outside any office have none)
facets.campaign: Election campaigns in which TR was a candidate
